_comment: Licenses accepted for modules shipped with MinDis - the policy of ADR 008,
in the canonical spelling produced by the license report's normalizer.
Entries without a moduleName are the permissive licenses allowed for any
module; entries with a moduleName are individually reviewed exceptions.
A module is accepted when at least one of the licenses it declares matches,
which is how a dual-licensed module is accepted under the permissive half.

allowedLicenses.moduleLicense: GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE, Version 2 + Classpath Exception
